objective: Review all generated outputs (Jupyter notebooks, cognitive dialogue reports, and mesh queue payloads) to ensure strict compliance with NASA TOPS and FAIR output principles. Automatically generate citations and attach open-science licenses to all synthesized research.
enforcement_rules: Every generated report must include a 'Data Provenance' section listing the DOIs of all ingested open-source datasets.
Apply the SPDX-License-Identifier: EUPL-1.2 (or compatible CC-BY 4.0 for data) to the header of all generated Markdown and Python files.
Ensure all generated JSON metadata includes a 'citation' and 'license' key.
Flag any output that lacks clear provenance for immediate self-healing correction.
